endpoints.name: locations_search_locations
endpoints.description: Search Sub-Account (Formerly Location) [GET /locations/search] Token: location or agency. Scopes: locations.readonly.

companyId.description: The company/agency id on which you want to perform the search

endpoints.name: locations_get_location
endpoints.description: Get Sub-Account (Formerly Location) Get details of a Sub-Account (Formerly Location) by passing the sub-account id [GET /locations/{locationId}] Token: location or agency. Scopes: locations.readonly.

endpoints.name: locations_put_location
endpoints.description: Put Sub-Account (Formerly Location) Update a Sub-Account (Formerly Location) based on the data provided [PUT /locations/{locationId}] Token: agency. Scopes: locations.write.

phone.description: The phone number of the business for which sub-account is created

address.description: The address of the business for which sub-account is created

city.description: The city where the business is located for which sub-account is created

state.description: The state in which the business operates for which sub-account is created

country.description: The country in which the business is present for which sub-account is created

postalCode.description: The postal code of the business for which sub-account is created

website.description: The website of the business for which sub-account is created

timezone.description: The timezone of the business for which sub-account is created

social.description: The social media links for location

override.description: If you want override all conflicted assets then pass true. Default value is false. (default: false)

snapshot.description: The snapshot to be updated in the location.

endpoints.name: locations_delete_location
endpoints.description: Delete Sub-Account (Formerly Location) Delete a Sub-Account (Formerly Location) from the Agency [DELETE /locations/{locationId}] Token: agency. Scopes: locations.internal-access-only.

deleteTwilioAccount.description: Boolean value to indicate whether to delete Twilio Account or not

endpoints.name: locations_get_location_tags
endpoints.description: Get Tags Get Sub-Account (Formerly Location) Tags [GET /locations/{locationId}/tags] Scopes: locations/tags.readonly.

endpoints.name: locations_create_tag
endpoints.description: Create Tag Create tag [POST /locations/{locationId}/tags] Scopes: locations/tags.write.

endpoints.name: locations_task_search
endpoints.description: Task Search Filter Task Search [POST /locations/{locationId}/tasks/search] Scopes: locations/tasks.readonly.

model.description: Model of the custom field you want to retrieve
Model of the custom field you want to create

model.description: Model of the custom field you want to update

endpoints.name: locations_upload_file_customfields
endpoints.description: Uploads File to customFields [POST /locations/{locationId}/customFields/upload] Scopes: locations/customFields.write.

endpoints.name: locations_get_timezones
endpoints.description: Fetch Timezones Fetch the available timezones [GET /locations/{locationId}/timezones] Token: location. Scopes: locations.readonly.

locationId.description: Path parameter "locationId", recovered from the URL template because the spec omits it.

endpoints.name: locations_get_all_or_email_sms_templates
endpoints.description: GET all or email/sms templates [GET /locations/{locationId}/templates] Scopes: locations/templates.readonly.
